ownerDecision: Default V1 commercial SEND policy — sponsor-owner may override with documented artifact.

baselineCompletenessStatuses.COMPLETE: All required baseline fields are sponsor-safe and non-defaulted.
baselineCompletenessStatuses.PARTIAL: Some labels exist but required fields are demo-derived, stale, or weakly classified.
baselineCompletenessStatuses.DEFAULTED: Scorecard or ROI model used default placeholders.
baselineCompletenessStatuses.NOT_COLLECTED: Required baselines missing or explicitly not collected.

requiredBaselineFields.label: Review cycle hours (baseline)
requiredBaselineFields.description: Wall-clock hours from review requested to approved manifest — PILOT_SUCCESS_SCORECARD §2.

requiredBaselineFields.label: Architect hours per review (baseline)
requiredBaselineFields.description: Person-hours of architect effort per review — PILOT_SUCCESS_SCORECARD §2.

optionalBaselineFields.label: Documentation hours per review (baseline)
optionalBaselineFields.description: Recommended for ARB/annual conversations; not blocking SEND.

override.notes: Override permits SEND when baselineCompletenessStatus is not COMPLETE. Does not clear proof BLOCK rows or DEFERRED_SCOPE.
